## Highlights

- Added native Windows x64 and ARM64 binary archives.
- Versioned agent-envd releases now also update the `latest` tag for the multi-architecture sandbox image.

## Packaging

- Windows binaries are distributed as ZIP archives containing `agent-envd.exe` and `LICENSE`.
- Linux and macOS binaries remain available as compressed tar archives.

## Upgrade notes

No configuration changes are required for this release.
